---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a feature, API addition, or roadmap change
title: "[feat] "
labels: enhancement
---

## Spec citation

If the feature is mandated or enabled by a spec, cite the section: e.g.
`specs/draft-ietf-webtrans-http3-15.txt §7`, `specs/rfc9297.txt §3.3`.
If it's purely an API ergonomics request, say so.

## Motivation

What problem does it solve? Concrete use case beats abstract framing.

## Proposed change

API sketch, new public class names, or a wire-format diagram. Pseudocode is
fine.

## Alternatives considered

Briefly: what else did you weigh, and why is the proposal better?

## Roadmap fit

Does this align with [docs/roadmap.md](../../docs/roadmap.md)? Which phase?
If it's out-of-band, explain why it should jump the queue.
